name: Nagyrozvágy (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagyrozvágy: a crowned red and blue shield with a figure in a boat and a sheep, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed NAGYROZVÁGY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagyrozvágy arms with crown, wreath and scroll
